name: Phoenyx: Breaking The Cycle
source:
Join two college girls on a trip to an abandoned cabin. The cabin has had numerous rumors about missing people going to it, and so, the girls are investigating both that and the cabin’s history for their final project. The cabin has a mysterious mirror with a thousand faces on it, too. Will their faces be added to the mirror frame like the rest?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3800840/Phoenyx_Breaking_The_Cycle/]Steam[/url]]
